description: Four stepped random voltage sources over a shared bus, which offers the sum, extremes and rectifications of whichever channels are switched into it

params.text: Switches that channel into the bus that feeds the ten jacks on the right
Sets the upper limit of that channel's random range, -5V to 5V
Sets the lower limit of that channel's random range, -5V to 5V
Picks the voltage that channel is scaled and clamped to: ±2.5V, ±5V or ±10V

inputs.text: A gate above 0.5V makes that channel pick a new value; with nothing patched, a channel takes the clock from the channel to its left
Adds to that channel's upper limit, one volt for one volt
Adds to that channel's lower limit, one volt for one volt

outputs.text: The sum of the channels switched into the bus, clamped to ±10V
The sum of the channels switched into the bus with its sign flipped
The highest voltage among the channels switched into the bus
The lowest voltage among the channels switched into the bus
The sum of the bus when it is positive and 0V when it is not
The sum of the bus when it is negative and 0V when it is not
The sum of the bus with its sign stripped, so it never goes below 0V
The sum of the bus with its sign stripped and then inverted, so it never goes above 0V
The sum of the bus divided by four
The sum of the bus with a slew on every change
